hookups.source: cpwshop campsiteDetails, parkID 50072, Lake Hasty loop (all 109 sites 'Electricity Hookup' 50; one 'Full Hookup' site with Water Hookup 'Y', Sewer Hookup 'Y') + CPW camping page ('electrical hook-ups (20, 30 and 50 amp)'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: All 109 sites have electric (2 ADA); one is full hookup. 18 pull-throughs; most sites list vehicles to 60-75 ft. 51 sites stay open in winter.

sites.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/john-martin-reservoir-state-park/john-martin-reservoir-state-park-camping-lodging ('The Lake Hasty Campground, located below the dam, is open year-round with electrical hook-ups at each of its 109 sites'; '51 sites remain open year-round') + cpwshop campsiteDetails (Driveway Entry 'Pull-Through' on 18), read 2026-10-27

values.note: Camper services building (flush restrooms, coin showers, laundry) open April 1 - October 31. The dump station is out of service for now (see note).

facilities.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/john-martin-reservoir-state-park/john-martin-reservoir-state-park-camping-lodging ('a camper services building open April 1 to October 31 with flush restrooms, a laundry room and coin-operated shower facilities'; amenities 'Dump station', 'Water station'; winter 'Potable water', 'Dump station'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: 51 Lake Hasty sites stay open in winter; the camper services building closes November 1 - March 31.

season.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/john-martin-reservoir-state-park/john-martin-reservoir-state-park-camping-lodging ('Camping is available year-round. At the Lake Hasty campground, 51 sites remain open year-round ... The camper services building is closed from November 1 to March 31'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: A reservation is required (cpwshop.com or 1-800-244-5613), up to six months ahead; a vehicle pass must be displayed. 14 days within a 28-day period; six people, two motorized vehicles and one camping unit per site. Check-in 1 p.m., check-out noon.

booking.source: https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/john-martin-reservoir-state-park/john-martin-reservoir-state-park-camping-lodging ('A reservation is required to camp at John Martin Reservoir State Park ... cpwshop.com or by phone at 1-800-244-5613. Reservations can be made up to six months in advance'; 'The maximum stay is 14 days within a 28-day period'), read 2026-10-27

values.note: June nights: electric $29, full hookup $36; Saturday $31 / $38. Plus tax, CPW's reservation fee and a vehicle pass ($4 a day to $120 a year per CPW's park listing).

fees.source: co_booking_rates_2026-10-12.jsonl (cpwshop Lake Hasty 2027-06-15: Electric '$29.00', Full Hookup '$36.00'; 2027-06-19: '$31.00', '$38.00') + https://cpw.state.co.us/state-parks/john-martin-reservoir-state-park/john-martin-reservoir-state-park-camping-lodging (Single campsite '$20-$38'; Park Pass '$4-$120'), read 2026-10-27

note: Lake Hasty Campground below the John Martin dam beside small Lake Hasty (not on the main reservoir); fish-cleaning station. As of 2026-10-27 CPW reports an underground electrical failure: half the campground is without power, those sites are closed to reservations, and the dump station is out of service; no repair date. --Claude
summary: CPW park + camping pages + all 109 cpwshop site pages: confirmed 109 sites, 50 A electric everywhere (one full-hookup site with water/sewer), pull-throughs, showers/laundry/dump, year-round, reservation-only on cpwshop, $29 + weekend $2 + full hookup $7. Added flush toilets, drinking water, season/facility notes, URL, 180-day window, 14-night max. Note: dropped field restatements, added the dated electrical-outage caveat.
flags: Partial closure (CPW alert, read 2026-10-27): 'An underground electrical line failure has left half of the campground without power & the sewer dump station out of service. Affected campsites are closed to reservations until further notice. Repair timeline is unknown.' Recorded as a dated note, not a status (half the campground operates).
Water/sewer true rests on a single full-hookup site (bookable, $36); every other site is electric only.
Max rig length not written: cpwshop lists 43-220 ft per site (most 60-75); CPW states no maximum.
The Point Campground (104 basic sites, north shore of the main reservoir, same cpwshop park) has no entry; basic/tent-oriented, likely no entry needed.
Pin ~170 m from the Lake Hasty site centroid (38.07453,-102.93503); fine.
